usage: queue.py [-h] --project-root PROJECT_ROOT --source SOURCE --train TRAIN
                --valid VALID --work-check WORK_CHECK --output OUTPUT
                [--device DEVICE] [--hard-seconds HARD_SECONDS]
                [--memory-wait-seconds MEMORY_WAIT_SECONDS]

One portable Molhiv family: 8 frozen arms x 3 seeds, no retry or analysis.

  --project-root PROJECT_ROOT
  --source SOURCE
  --train TRAIN
  --valid VALID
  --work-check WORK_CHECK
  --output OUTPUT
  --device DEVICE
  --hard-seconds HARD_SECONDS
  --memory-wait-seconds MEMORY_WAIT_SECONDS
